title: Selecting an inactive part in global search opens the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • The top-bar Search is the new global search, which is on by default for every account.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSOPEN-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL GSOPEN PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Work Orders (any page other than Inventory).
  2. Click "Search" in the top bar and type {Part-A}.
  3. Click the {Part-A} result.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {Part-A} is listed with its grey "Inactive" tag.
  • Step 3: Parts → Inventory opens on the Inactive tab (selected), with {Part-A} in the search box and the {Part-A} row listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R18, S9-R19, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows global search. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §6 Phase 7 browser-walk. QA lead's set-up answer of 9 Oct 2026 (question 3). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R18: “Global search lists inactive parts at the current location. Each carries the grey "Inactive" tag.”
  • S9-R19: “Selecting an inactive part in global search opens the Inventory list on the Inactive tab, searched to its part number.”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §6 Phase 7 browser-walk: “global search (Search v2 org): the part shows the grey "Inactive" tag; selecting it opens the Inactive tab searched to its number; an untracked part shows "Not Tracked"”
